tests.stage: final completed comparison, report and archive harness

category_explanation: Reachable tasks separate search failure from impossible targets; family diversity and generator controls limit generality, work caps can suppress the class gradient, and fixed product readout rejects genuinely non-CSS candidates.
dominant_limitation: ALGORITHM_LIMITATION (no established general advantage at 32 slots) combined with BENCHMARK_LIMITATION (few related parents and limited seed/family power)
next_experiment: A prospectively fixed matched evaluation-budget staircase on the same development tasks and seeds, keeping search operators, targets and certification caps fixed, to distinguish budget insufficiency from persistent guidance failure
